purpose: Declares the single authoritative representation for information shared by the Partial Cubes database and LaTeX workspace while preserving each paper as a scholarly artifact.

migration.promotion_rule: A normalized fact becomes database-owned only after its reviewed batch and any selected LaTeX consumer pass preservation and build checks.
migration.preservation_rule: Only blocks explicitly classified as generated_catalogue may be replaced. Paper-specific statements, full proofs, narrative, notation, diagrams, and document organization remain in LaTeX.

class_catalogue.scope: accepted records only; unmigrated class material remains LaTeX-owned
class_catalogue.status: Class identity, aliases, category, scope, catalogue summary, and derived closure summaries have one structured source.

class_characterizations.scope: accepted records only; paper-local formulations remain part of their source artifacts
class_characterizations.status: The database owns canonical catalogue criteria. A selected active survey may import them; archival theorem papers need not be rewritten.

structured_claims.source: data/characterization_equivalences/*.json, data/relations/*.json, data/operation_results/*.json, data/invariant_values/*.json, data/obstruction_bases/*.json, and data/results/*.json
structured_claims.status: The website and graphs derive from these typed facts. Add a generated LaTeX view only for a named consumer.

concise_catalogue_proofs.source: proof fields in database claim records
concise_catalogue_proofs.status: A concise proof may be generated for a deliberate consumer in the future. It does not replace a paper's canonical full proof.

canonical_full_proofs.database_pointer: proof_source and references fields in database claim records
canonical_full_proofs.status: The database owns the normalized fact; the source paper owns its full proof and paper-specific theorem formulation.

bibliography.scope: shared references required by accepted database records and generated catalogue material
bibliography.status: Paper-only bibliography entries may remain in local LaTeX bibliographies.

paper_artifacts.status: Narrative, motivation, historical discussion, paper-specific statements, notation, full proofs, diagrams, examples in context, and document organization remain authored LaTeX.

survey_diagram_presentation.source: the survey's authored TikZ and explanatory hierarchy
survey_diagram_presentation.database_output: docs/ graph views derived independently from accepted structured facts

open_questions_and_campaign_state.source: ~/latex/PartialCubes papers, ledgers, dashboards, and research notes
open_questions_and_campaign_state.status: Only a precise catalogue claim is promoted. The broader programme and working state stay in LaTeX.
